summary: Torch tower in Saskatchewan: listed with coordinates on websiteservice.ca, with towermen named 1960s to 1994; no build date, height or current status found.

facts.status_note: No source we found says whether the tower still stands.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tower-list entry gives coordinates only: no height, build date, status, access or notes. The towermen list is scrambled in places. A 'Torch Tower' entry for 1972-1973 sits beside the names Jonny Brown and Kara Grunderud, and the layout does not show which name it belongs to, so it is left out. The story assumes 'Torch' in the towermen list means this tower. The Canada Lookouts Saskatchewan index lists Torch, but canada-lookouts.weebly.com/torch.html returned HTTP 404, so no Canada Lookouts page was used. The brief's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency) is not named in any fetched source. A 2013 item in the firelookout.org news archive (https://firelookout.org/resources/archives/past-news/) says fire lookout stations in northern Saskatchewan would be replaced with cameras; it does not name Torch, so it is not used here. Nothing fetched describes the site today, and no photos were found.
